content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Casino gaming operator; gaming wagers and hotels differ from steakhouse restaurant dining."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Drive-thru coffee shops selling espresso drinks, not casual dining steakhouse meals."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Operates and franchises casual seafood and steak restaurants serving diners, like the target; liquor retail is a side line."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Franchisor of blue-collar staffing offices; it places workers rather than serving restaurant meals."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures packaged meats for grocery and foodservice; it does not operate restaurants serving diners."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel center retailer selling groceries to households, not prepared restaurant meals."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Live entertainment venue operator selling tickets and event services; food is secondary to events."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Casino resort operator whose gaming revenue dominates; restaurants only support the casino properties."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Las Vegas casino resorts earning mainly from gaming, lodging and entertainment, not steakhouse dining."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases hotels to travelers; lodging is the core business, not restaurant dining."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Operates and licenses upscale and casual steakhouse restaurants serving diners, closely matching the target's concept and model."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Quick-service hamburger chain with drive-thru and franchising; a different format from casual dining steakhouses."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Home furnishings and kitchenware retailer; sells household goods, not restaurant meals."}]}
